scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing SBD-WSUS01 behind the core with both domain controllers and SBD-DHCP01, the 50 Windows PCs and both administration seats in front, and the update and console paths each lesson adds.
scene.completeCaption: Every Windows system takes updates only from SBD-WSUS01: a month’s content imported from hashed media, approved ring by ring, and installed on the domain controllers last, by Tier 0, one at a time.

nodes.name: SBD-WSUS01
nodes.title: SBD-WSUS01 · 10.0.20.30
nodes.description: The only road Windows updates travel. It never synchronizes: each month’s metadata and files arrive on hashed media and are imported. Members check metadata over HTTPS 8531 and pull signed files over HTTP 8530 (F06).

nodes.name: SBD-DC02
nodes.title: SBD-DC02 · 10.0.10.11
nodes.description: Ring 4. It downloads on its own but installs only when a Tier 0 operator starts it — the first of the two controllers, checked with dcdiag and repadmin before SBD-DC01 follows.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: Ring 4, installed only after SBD-DC02 is healthy again. It is the PDC emulator and the domain’s time source, so it never restarts while its partner is down.

nodes.name: SBD-DHCP01
nodes.title: SBD-DHCP01 · 10.0.20.10
nodes.description: Ring 3, with the other member servers: it installs only what the pilot and the workstations have already proven, in its own install window.

nodes.name: 50 Windows PCs
nodes.title: 50 Windows PCs · 10.0.80.100–199
nodes.description: SBD-PC01–SBD-PC03 are Ring 1, the pilot; the other 47 are Ring 2. Each files itself into its ring by Group Policy and installs on its schedule, or at the approval’s deadline.

nodes.name: SBD-ADMIN-SRV01
nodes.title: SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 · 10.0.60.20
nodes.description: The Tier 1 seat (rule A02): the patch operators build and run SBD-WSUS01 from here, run each month’s import on it, and approve Rings 1 to 3. The seat itself sits in Ring 3.

nodes.name: AdminJumpBox01
nodes.title: AdminJumpBox01 · 10.0.60.10
nodes.description: The Tier 0 seat (rule A01): it owns the ring GPOs and the group changes, checks who approved each Ring 4 update, and installs the controllers by hand. It is the last system in Ring 4.

chapters.network: SBD-WSUS01 is planned on VLAN 20. The domain controllers, the member servers, the fleet and both administration seats run from earlier courses; no update path is shown until the server exists, and its content will only ever arrive on media.

SBD-WSUS01 is live on VLAN 20 and administered from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01. It has no route out and no clients yet; its metadata port, 8531, now answers only over TLS with a certificate from the course 1.1 issuing CA.

No network path crosses the boundary: the month’s metadata package and update files arrive on approved media, carried by an authorized operator, and are imported on SBD-WSUS01 in a Tier 1 session from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01.

Every Windows system now checks SBD-WSUS01 for metadata over HTTPS 8531 and files itself into its ring: the PCs into Rings 1 and 2, the member servers into Ring 3, SBD-AUDIT01 into its own custodian-installed Ring 3 group, and the domain controllers into Ring 4. The ring GPOs come from AdminJumpBox01; nothing is approved yet.

The month’s approved updates flow ring by ring: the pilot first, then the workstations and member servers on their deadlines, SBD-AUDIT01 when its custodian installs, then the controllers by hand from AdminJumpBox01 — SBD-DC02, then SBD-DC01.
